visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a bright yellow, layered mango cake topped with white coconut flakes. A wooden spoon gently presses into the side of the soft cake. The background is a warm, slightly blurred kitchen setting. (2) Hands enter the frame over a glass bowl. White granulated sugar is poured from a small container into the bowl. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting. (3) A hand pours bright orange mango puree into the same bowl, followed by coconut milk and fresh cream. A wire whisk is used to blend the liquids into a smooth, pale yellow mixture. (4) The mixture is poured into a black saucepan on a stove. A whisk continues to stir as the liquid heats up and begins to thicken slightly. Small bubbles appear on the surface. (5) In a separate bowl, a hand stirs a mixture of white powder and milk with a spoon until smooth. (6) The milk-starch mixture is added to the saucepan with the mango base. The person uses a large grey spoon to stir the mixture as it becomes thick, glossy, and custard-like. (7) The thick yellow custard is poured into a rectangular metal tray lined with plastic wrap. A spoon levels the surface. Coconut flakes are sprinkled generously over the top. (8) The chilled cake is removed from the tray. A hand wraps it in plastic. It is then placed on a wooden cutting board, more coconut flakes are sprinkled, and a metal knife cuts it into rectangular blocks. (9) Final close-up shots show the finished mango snow cakes, looking soft and vibrantly yellow, plated on a wooden surface with a sprig of green garnish.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a friendly male voice speaking in Mandarin Chinese, introducing the 'Mango Snow Cake.' Upbeat acoustic guitar music with a light percussion beat starts immediately. (2) There is a soft 'splash' sound as mango puree is poured. The narrator's pitch is moderate, maintaining a professional yet inviting tone while listing the initial ingredients. (3) A series of metallic whisking and bowl-clinking sounds occur as the batter is mixed. The BGM remains steady at 120 BPM. (4) As the liquid hits the saucepan, a subtle sizzle and liquid movement sound are heard. The speaker continues explaining the heating process with clear articulation. (5) A distinct clink of a spoon against a ceramic bowl is heard when mixing the milk and cornstarch. (6) The stirring sounds become 'thicker' and more resonant as the custard reaches a viscous consistency in the pot. (7) Final segment features the sound of a knife cutting through the soft cake on a wooden board, with a light percussive thud. The narrator closes with a concluding remark as the music fades out.
